notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.noOsDelivery: This panel shows in-app state only. Desktop delivery needs its own OS permission and is not requested here.
notifications.preferencesAbsent: Notification preferences are not available yet: the delivered Core contract has no notification preference store, so there is nothing to change or save here. The list below is the delivered in-app surface; desktop delivery is not part of it.

blocked.noCore: Notifications are unavailable: no Core transport answered at this app origin, so there is no notification source to read. The Core's local transport is opt-in and disabled by default; this is never shown as an empty list.
blocked.noSession: Notifications are unavailable: no Core session is established at this app origin, so no authorized notification read can run. Connect from the first-run setup with a one-time bootstrap credential.
blocked.sessionExpired: Notifications are unavailable: the session this page held is no longer authorized by the Core (it expired, was revoked, or is otherwise invalid). The token has been discarded from this page's memory; reconnect from the first-run setup with a fresh one-time credential.
blocked.connecting: Checking the Core connection: the notification reads start once a Core session answers an authorized read.

notifications.announceData: Notification groups shown on this page: {{count}}
notifications.emptyAllBody: Nothing has been notified yet. Job results, failures, approval waits, and other Core-recorded transitions appear here when the Core raises them.
notifications.emptyFiltered: No notifications match the active filter
notifications.emptyFilteredBody: Notifications exist, but none match the category and read-state filters. Clearing the filters shows the full list.
notifications.failureBody: The Core refused the notification read. The typed code below is the Core's own refusal — nothing was fabricated to fill the list; refreshing is your explicit action.
notifications.unknownTitle: The notification read's outcome is unknown
notifications.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the notification read. Nothing is known about the list until a read is confirmed — this is never shown as an empty list. Refresh reads the current state from the Core.

entry.noDestination: This notification's destination route is not part of the delivered surfaces yet, so it cannot be opened from here.

actions.scopeNote: Actions apply to the entry's newest notification: the Core mutates exactly the notification identity named — nothing else.
actions.refusedBody: The typed code below is the Core's own refusal; nothing was applied unless the Core says otherwise. Trying again is your explicit action.
actions.unknownBody: The response was lost, so it is never proof the action was recorded or not. The recovery is a query, never a resend: refreshing reads the current state from the Core.

notifications.lawNote: Marking read or clearing a notification never changes the underlying Job, approval, or any other record — a read approval notification is not an approved approval. Approval happens only through the explicit accept or reject command on the Job detail.
